summary.text: Jeremy Todd, a Libertarian Party candidate and Northern Kentucky resident, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Kentucky's 4th Congressional District to Ed Gallrein.
In his Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey he describes himself as a Christian and a Libertarian with a business career.

paragraphs.text: In his Ballotpedia survey, Todd says he was born and raised in the South, the son of a truck driver and a billing clerk.
He says he built a career in business, leading teams ranging from a handful of employees to organizations of more than 300 people; the survey does not name employers.
He describes himself as a husband and father who holds Christian and Libertarian views, favoring individual liberty, limited government and personal responsibility.

According to LINK nky, Todd's nomination petition, with more than 750 signatures, was submitted to the Kentucky Secretary of State's office on June 2, 2026, after Rep. Thomas Massie lost the Republican primary to Ed Gallrein.
He campaigned on reducing federal debt and money printing, ending overseas military commitments, and opposing government surveillance.
He received 4.9% of the vote to Ed Gallrein's 54.2%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
